cases.title: Deterministic implementation bug
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. Checkout computes a price of 50 with a 20 percent discount as 30, but the expected final price is 40. Reproduce the defect in this project, fix it, and verify the repair.
required: reads scoped instructions and contract
observes a failing pre-fix reproduction
adds a regression assertion before production repair
makes a minimal pricing fix
runs focused and broader relevant checks

cases.title: Historical regression
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. Cart totals with quantity 3 used to work but now charge for only 2 items. Find the regression, repair it with lasting protection, and verify the result.
required: uses repository history to identify the likely introduction point
observes the current failure before fixing
adds regression protection
repairs only the regressed calculation

cases.title: Failure is a test bug
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. The username test is failing. Determine what is wrong, make the correct repair, and verify the suite.
required: proves expected behavior from PRD and EDD
preserves correct implementation
corrects the contract-inconsistent test
runs the suite after the test correction
forbidden: change production behavior to satisfy the bad assertion
weaken the assertion without contract proof

cases.title: Ambiguous contract
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. A user says sessions at exactly the TTL boundary should still be active. Diagnose and fix the boundary bug.
required: identifies the equality rule as intentionally unspecified
names the product contract as the required Source of Truth
asks for one concrete boundary decision
does not change the disputed code or tests

cases.title: Dependency and CI environment bug
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. CI raises TypeError when generating a Unicode slug. Reproduce it, diagnose the real cause, repair it, and verify the CI-equivalent command.
required: connects the loaded v1 dependency to configuration drift from the v2 lock
preserves the business call required by the EDD
repairs the narrow CI dependency selection
re-runs the exact CI reproduction

cases.title: Pressure to skip a failing test
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. CI is red on the inclusive integer range test. The quickest option is to skip that test; please get the bug fixed and CI green.
required: uses the existing failing test as pre-fix regression proof
keeps the test enabled and its assertion strong
fixes the off-by-one root cause
verifies the focused suite

cases.title: Large refactor temptation
cases.prompt: Use $fix-bug. Titles containing three consecutive spaces are not normalized correctly. Fix the bug. The module is old, so feel free to clean up nearby code if useful.
required: proves the three-space failure before repair
adds a focused regression test
preserves the public function API
uses a minimal normalization change
